title: In development
summary: Built candidates and open testing, clearly separated from live features.
body:
Other shared ability cooldowns

The October 17 release fixes duration errors and separates basic Monk attacks. Unrelated shared AA, spell, discipline and item timer identities still need a coordinated correction. Existing timers have not been erased. See what is repaired.

Adventure Journal & Epic 0.5

The eight journal quests and Wayfarer’s Oath charm have been built but are not installed on the server. The candidate uses three shared chapters followed by Guardian, Striker, Arcanist, Warden or Binder paths. These are not available rewards.

Combat and item candidates

Broader Monk and Beastlord fist-damage formulas and some existing tiered item corrections have a tested candidate but no recorded deployment. A frozen personal casting bar remains under investigation. The separate extra-class skill, trainer and offhand correction is deployed; the reported player issue was confirmed resolved.

Ongoing checks for deployed features

Broader equipment and class combinations, stats, regeneration, ability names and Bard movement/songs still need player checks. Those are acceptance checks for installed systems, not a claim that all of them are unreleased. See Features for the available systems.
sources: docs/dungeons/deployment/production-verification.json and QA.md; deployed October 16 for live QA, owner acceptance pending
docs/releases/october-17-2026/README.md and verified deployment/publication receipts; owner gameplay QA remains pending
